name: threejs-animation
title_zh: 在浏览器里编排三维动画的完整工作台
tagline_zh: GLTF 动画、骨骼蒙皮、形变目标、动画混合，一次装齐。不用再翻文档拼 API，直接上手调出电影级动效。
tagline_en: Keyframe, skeletal, morph, and mixing—all in one. Stop hunting docs, start directing motion like a pro.
desc_en: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.
why_zh: 不是零散示例，而是把 Three.js 动画四件套串成一条流水线：从加载到混合，状态机替你管好每一帧。
why_en: Not scattered snippets—a pipeline linking load, play, and blend, with a state machine owning every frame.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 动画域，不碰物理引擎或自定义着色器。需要你已有 GLTF 模型或基本场景；不负责建模。
limit_en: Only Three.js animation—no physics or shaders. Requires your own GLTF models and scene; no modeling, no collision handling.
